The '''2018–19 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Texas at Austin]] in the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by fourth-year head coach [[Shaka Smart]] and played their home games at the [[Frank Erwin Center]] in [[Austin, Texas]] as members of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. The team won the 2019 National Invitational Tournament with Senior Forward Dylan Osetkowski being named MVP.

==Previous season==
The [[2017–18 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Longhorns]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 19–15, 8–10 in [[2017–18 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in seventh place. They defeated [[2017–18 Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball team|Iowa State]] in the first round of the [[2018 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]]<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.desmoinesregister.com/story/sports/college/iowa-state/basketball-mens/2018/03/07/what-we-learned-texas-68-iowa-state-basketball-64-big-12-basketball-tournament/403078002/|title=What we learned: Texas 68, Iowa State 64|work=Des Moines Register|access-date=2018-04-05|language=en}}</ref> before losing to [[2017–18 Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball team|Texas Tech]] in the quarterfinals.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/texas-loses-to-texas-tech-but-beats-adversity-in-big-12-quarterfinals/|title=Texas loses to Texas Tech, but beats adversity, in Big 12 quarterfinals|work=CBSSports.com|access-date=2018-04-05|language=en}}</ref> They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 10 seed in the South region where they lost to [[2017–18 Nevada Wolf Pack men's basketball team|Nevada]] in the first round.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401025817|title=Texas vs. Nevada – Game Recap – March 16, 2018 – ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2018-04-05}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://sportsday.dallasnews.com/college-sports/collegesports/2018/03/16/texas-vs-nevada-basketball-live-updates|title=Nevada 87, Texas 83: Recap, analysis, reaction and more from the Longhorns' loss|date=2018-03-16|work=SportsDay|access-date=2018-04-05|language=en}}</ref>
